title: I turned an old r/AskMen thread into a Godot game. Would you play it?
author: TokenChingy
selftext:
Hoping to get more love here than hate...  
  
I’m making *Kindergartners*, a classroom survival brawler in Godot. You’re the only adult in the room when the first wave of five rushes in. The goal is to see how long you can stay on your feet. It started with [an old r/AskMen thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/AskMen/comments/crxzvd/how_many_kindergartners_do_you_think_you_could/).

**Would you give it a go?** I’m curious what would make you come back after the first couple of rounds. Would you rather try to beat your own time, survive with a mate in co-op, or play a versus mode where one person is the adult and everyone else plays some of the kids, then you swap sides?

replies.author: TokenChingy
replies.body: What would like to see most in a game like this?

comments.author: Massivemployer25
comments.body: I think this is really funny. But I could also see some people saying it encourages child abuse. So you should be careful. Maybe give a good story reason for the fighting, and make sure the player knows none of the child characters are seriously harmed.

replies.author: TokenChingy
replies.body: No kids were harmed in the making of this game 👍
